subject.title: [V3.5] Data ficha producto adaptada por idioma del dominio

question: Should R18 be sponsored now as a large ecommerce data/localization track, and should the first implementation milestone be benchmark plus storage contract before PDP/admin work?
rationale: The remaining scope is a product/data decision across LLM provider cost, Mongo schema, pipeline timing, fallback behavior, and admin ownership rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Benchmark and contract first
options.body: Run the 50-product benchmark and agree on `Product.translations` storage/fallback semantics before building pipeline, PDP, or admin UI.

options.title: Narrow PDP-only milestone
options.body: Ship only title suffix and read-path fallback after a minimal data contract, leaving pipeline/admin overrides for later issues.

options.title: Defer R18
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not start implementation until V3.5 owners prioritize the data cost and manual-override workflow.

recommendation.title: Benchmark and contract first
recommendation.body: Run the 50-product benchmark and agree on `Product.translations` storage/fallback semantics before building pipeline, PDP, or admin UI.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle authored the issue and latest scope updates, and also appears in current PDP description history.
